{{Quote|The portside deflectors are gone!|The clone navigation officer|<ref name="Nightsisters (episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''clone navigation officer''' served under [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] on the bridge of his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], during the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]]. After [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] attacked the ship directly, this clone informed Wullf that the ship's port side deflectors were gone.
